summary.text: Floyd Taylor is an independent write-in candidate for Indiana's 9th Congressional District, a local business owner and cancer survivor, according to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a computer engineer.

In his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, describes himself as a Hoosier, husband, and local business owner, and a network architect with more than 25 years of experience securing critical infrastructure for institutions including Jefferson Public Radio, Fort Knox, Purdue University, and the U.S. Census Bureau.

Says he built the Congress App (thecongressapp.com), which he describes as publishing bills in plain language with fiscal breakdowns and letting verified district constituents weigh in. He says he takes no PAC or party money.
Is running as a write-in independent in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists no prior candidacies for him.
